name: world-forge
description: Procedural fantasy world generator: a headless core, the atlas app that maps it, and a roguelike that walks it

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @worldforge/atlas
scripts.build:game: npm run typecheck -w @worldforge/game && npm run build -w @worldforge/game
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @worldforge/core && npm run typecheck -w @worldforge/atlas && npm run typecheck -w @worldforge/game && npm run typecheck -w @worldforge/desktop && node tools/check-cycles.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test -w @worldforge/game && npm run test:core -- --check
